title: Edit files from an old Windows system without changing their encoding
prompt:
The two files in legacy/ come from an old Windows accounting machine and go back to it afterwards, so each must keep exactly the encoding and line endings it has now. Please:

1. In legacy/settings.ini: the archive folder moves from 2023 to 2024 (same path otherwise), and the export delimiter becomes | instead of ;.
2. In legacy/клиенты.csv: customer 1047 moved to Нижний Новгород; customer 1012 paid in 150,50, so add that to their balance (keep the number format the file uses); and add a new customer at the end: id 1101, Зоя Щукина, Тверь, balance 0,00.
3. Write legacy/summary.json (plain UTF-8) from the updated customer file: {"customers": <how many>, "total_balance": <sum of all balances, as a number>, "cities": [<each city once, sorted>]}.

Change nothing else in the two files.
